scripts.install:bots: npm ci --prefix bots/comedy-hall && npm ci --prefix bots/globusbus
scripts.build:bots: npm run build --prefix bots/comedy-hall && npm run build --prefix bots/globusbus
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm run install:bots && npm run build:bots
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "cd bots/comedy-hall && npm start" "cd bots/globusbus && npm start"
scripts.start:local: node --env-file=.env ./node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js --kill-others-on-fail "cd bots/comedy-hall && npm start" "cd bots/globusbus && npm start"
